title: 自己紹介: 初対面の同僚と
situation: You are Mia, a colleague meeting the learner for the first time at a small company get-together. Chat casually: names, where they are from, what they do, what they like doing outside work. Ask follow-up questions and share a little about yourself so it feels like a real conversation, not an interview.
learnerRole: 転職してきたばかりのエンジニア

targets.reading: ナイス・トゥ・ミーチュー
targets.example: Hi, I'm Ken. Nice to meet you.
I work as a backend engineer.
In my free time I go climbing.
I like coffee. How about you?

drills.ja: はじめまして。ケンです。
drills.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Ken.
accept: Nice to meet you, I'm Ken.

drills.ja: バックエンドのエンジニアとして働いています。
drills.en: I work as a backend engineer.
accept: I'm working as a backend engineer.

drills.ja: 空いた時間にはクライミングに行きます。
drills.en: In my free time I go climbing.
accept: I go climbing in my free time.

drills.ja: 私はコーヒーが好きです。あなたは？
drills.en: I like coffee. How about you?
